# Marga

Marga is a study tracker and revision planner for Indian students.

Supported exams:
- JEE (Main & Advanced)
- NEET
- ISC
- CBSE
- KCET
- MHTCET
- custom exams

Primary pages:
https://mymarga.in/
https://mymarga.in/jee-study-tracker
https://mymarga.in/neet-study-planner
https://mymarga.in/isc-study-organizer
https://mymarga.in/cbse-study-planner

Application:
https://mymarga.in/app

Notes:
- /app requires login
- public pages describe the product

Offline Support:
Core study tracking supports offline usage and syncs changes when connectivity returns.
